final: SELECT g.zone, g.entry, g.avg_traits, g.cnt, CAST(g.cnt AS REAL) / t.total AS ratio FROM (SELECT sf.zoneref AS zone, s.entrystat AS entry, AVG(sf.traitcount) AS avg_traits, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM scanfeatures sf JOIN sites s ON s.zoneregistry = sf.zoneref WHERE sf.traitcount >= 489 GROUP BY sf.zoneref, s.entrystat) g CROSS JOIN (SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM scanfeatures sf2 JOIN sites s2 ON s2.zoneregistry = sf2.zoneref WHERE sf2.traitcount >= 489 GROUP BY sf2.zoneref, s2.entrystat)) t WHERE t.total IS NOT NULL ORDER BY (CAST(g.cnt AS REAL) / t.total) IS NULL, CAST(g.cnt AS REAL) / t.total DESC LIMIT 10
